name: Stratified Morse Theory for Euler Characteristic
aliases: Method of Manufactured Solutions (MMS) using Stratified Morse Theory
Stratified Morse Theory (SMT) for Euler Characteristic
definition: A method to compute the Euler characteristic χ of any regular isosurface of a piecewise trilinear interpolant by analyzing critical points on a stratified grid, handling non-smoothness at cell boundaries.
summary: Stratified Morse Theory for Euler Characteristic verifies isosurface extraction algorithms by computing topological invariants via critical point analysis on stratified grid components, handling non-smoothness where other methods fail.
